Test Scenario: Login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.  5. Open the dashboard.
Expected Result: User is authenticated, redirected to the dashboard and a session is created

Test Scenario: Login with an invalid username
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Access is denied and an error message is displayed

Test Scenario: Login with an incorrect password
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Access is denied and an error message is displayed

Test Scenario: Submit the form with both fields empty
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Leave both fields empty.  3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Required-field validation is displayed

Test Scenario: Submit the form with an empty username
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter only the password.  3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Username validation is displayed

Test Scenario: Submit the form with an empty password
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter only the username.  3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Password validation is displayed

Test Scenario: Username length 4 (below minimum of 5)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Validation message: username must be 5 to 12 characters

Test Scenario: Username length 5 and password length 8 (minimum values)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Login succeeds

Test Scenario: Username length 12 and password length 16 (maximum values)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Login succeeds

Test Scenario: Username length 13 (above maximum of 12)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Validation message: username must be 5 to 12 characters

Test Scenario: Password length 7 (below minimum of 8)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Validation message: password must be 8 to 16 characters

Test Scenario: Password length 17 (above maximum of 16)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Validation message: password must be 8 to 16 characters

Test Scenario: Repeated failed login attempts (account protection)
Preconditions: User rohan123 is registered, not locked
Test Steps: 1. Submit a wrong password 5 times.  2. Submit the correct password.
Expected Result: After 5 failures the account is locked; the 6th attempt is rejected with a lock message

Test Scenario: SQL injection in the username field
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Input is treated as data; access denied; no server error

Test Scenario: SQL injection in the password field
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Input is treated as data; access denied; no server error

Test Scenario: Script injection (XSS) in the username field
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Access denied; the script is not reflected unescaped in the page

Test Scenario: Account enumeration: compare errors for unknown user and wrong password
Test Steps: 1. Submit an unknown username.  2. Submit a valid username with a wrong password.  3. Compare the responses.
Expected Result: Both responses are identical, so valid usernames are not revealed

Test Scenario: Password is masked and stored as a hash
Test Input: Open the page and inspect the user table
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Check the password input type.  3. Read the stored value for rohan123.
Expected Result: Password input is masked; stored value is a hash, not plain text

Test Scenario: Session cookie has the HttpOnly flag
Test Steps: 1. Log in.  2. Read the Set-Cookie header.
Expected Result: Session cookie is marked HttpOnly

Test Scenario: Open a protected page without logging in
Test Steps: 1. Open /dashboard directly.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page

Test Scenario: Logout ends the session
Test Steps: 1. Log in.  2. Click Logout.  3. Open /dashboard.
Expected Result: After logout the dashboard redirects to the login page

Test Scenario: Reuse of an old session cookie after logout
Preconditions: User logged in and logged out; old cookie saved
Test Steps: 1. Log in and save the session cookie.  2. Log out.  3. Send the saved cookie to /dashboard.
Expected Result: Protected page is not accessible; redirect to login

Test Scenario: Username with the wrong letter case
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Access is denied (usernames are case-sensitive)

Test Scenario: Password with a leading or trailing space
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Access is denied (spaces are part of the password)

Test Scenario: Very long input (1000 characters)
Test Steps: 1. Open /login.  2. Enter the username and password.  3. Click Login.  4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Handled without a server error; access denied

Test Scenario: Account lock expires after 15 minutes
Preconditions: Account locked by TC-13 (depends on TC-13)
Test Input: Correct password at 14 min and at 15 min 1 s
Test Steps: 1. Lock the account.  2. Try after 14 minutes.  3. Try after 15 minutes.
Expected Result: Still locked at 14 minutes; login succeeds after 15 minutes

Test Scenario: Login over HTTPS (credentials encrypted in transit)
Test Steps: 1. Open the https:// URL.  2. Log in.  3. Check the connection and cookie flags.
Expected Result: Login works over HTTPS; session cookie has the Secure flag

Test Scenario: Login in Firefox and Safari
Test Steps: 1. Open /login in each browser.  2. Log in.
Expected Result: Login works the same as in Chromium
